description: This file is a shell script configuring wireless network interfaces in OpenWrt using mac80211 and related tools. It includes functions for configuring Wi-Fi interfaces, capabilities, mesh, adhoc, monitor modes, and integrates with hostapd and wpa_supplicant. The script handles device and interface configurations, PHY management, and channel settings.

methods.name: wdev_tool
methods.description: Executes a uCode script with given arguments for wireless device management.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Wraps ubus call with locking for safe execution.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_device_config
methods.description: Initializes device-specific hostapd configuration.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_iface_config
methods.description: Initializes interface-specific hostapd configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capability flags to a configuration variable based on masks and input.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds High Efficiency (HE) capabilities based on input parameters.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up base configuration for hostapd per PHY.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures a BSS block in hostapd for a given interface.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for a given PHY at a specific index.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a device using wdev tool.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Finds the PHY name associated with a given system path from /etc/board.json.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames a PHY based on path information.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames a PHY based on JSON configuration.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Attempts to locate the PHY based on various identifiers and renames it accordingly.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Marks presence of an AP interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets a unique interface name based on a prefix and index.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface, assigning MAC addresses, modes, and configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Configures an adhoc wireless network interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Configures a mesh wireless network interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Configures a monitor mode interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets transmission power for a VIF.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a new interface to wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sets the wireless interface configuration in wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Sets the hostapd configuration for a PHY.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts wpa_supplicant for a PHY and radio.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Configures wpa_supplicant for a VIF.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Sets up a virtual interface, including supplicant and hostapd if needed.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Converts channel to frequency for a PHY.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel is DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Sets the interface to no-scan mode.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets the configuration files for hostapd and wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for PHY and VIF names based on radio index.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main driver setup function for mac80211 including PHY and interface setup.

methods.name: add_driver
methods.description: Registers the mac80211 driver with the system.
